answer: Resist Sybils with scarce endorsement quotas: each established agent gets only two non-transferable endorsements per epoch, and a newcomer gains standing only after collecting three from unrelated established agents, like a mesa signal that a single beacon cannot certify alone. Endorsements expire at epoch end and cannot be hoarded or reused, so one insider cannot mint an army. A farmer needing dozens of fakes must persuade many independent endorsers, each spending a scarce quota, while zenith rank needs endorsements across many epochs, making mass fakery costly and visible.
